cards.example: 孟子继承了孔子的思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencius inherited Confucius's thought.

cards.example: 恻隐之心就是同情心。
cards.exampleTranslation: The heart of compassion is sympathy.

cards.example: 做错事要有羞耻心。
cards.exampleTranslation: One should feel shame after doing wrong.

cards.example: 我们要学会谦让。
cards.exampleTranslation: We should learn to be modest and yield to others.

cards.example: 是非之心能分辨善恶。
cards.exampleTranslation: The sense of right and wrong can distinguish good from evil.

cards.example: 人与动物有根本区别。
cards.exampleTranslation: Humans and animals have fundamental differences.

cards.example: 正义是重要的道德观念。
cards.exampleTranslation: Justice is an important moral concept.

cards.back: to be impatient for quick success
cards.example: 学习语言不能急于求成。
cards.exampleTranslation: You cannot be impatient for quick success when learning a language.

cards.example: 道德品质是逐渐培养起来的。
cards.exampleTranslation: Moral character is cultivated gradually.

cards.example: 学校要培养学生的品德。
cards.exampleTranslation: Schools should cultivate students' moral character.

cards.example: 人民是国家的基础。
cards.exampleTranslation: The people are the foundation of the nation.

cards.example: 教育是社会发展的基础。
cards.exampleTranslation: Education is the foundation of social development.

cards.example: 爱人民的人会受到拥护。
cards.exampleTranslation: Those who love the people will gain support.

cards.example: 他有资格参加这个考试。
cards.exampleTranslation: He is qualified to take this exam.

cards.example: 孟子是著名的思想家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Mencius was a famous thinker.

cards.example: 中国古代有很多圣人思想。
cards.exampleTranslation: Ancient China had many sage traditions.

cards.example: 同情心是重要的道德起点。
cards.exampleTranslation: Compassion is an important moral starting point.

cards.example: 我们要学会分别对错。
cards.exampleTranslation: We should learn to distinguish right from wrong.

cards.example: 这是人与动物的根本区别。
cards.exampleTranslation: This is the fundamental difference between humans and animals.

cards.example: 仁义礼智都是美德。
cards.exampleTranslation: Benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom are all virtues.

cards.example: 幼苗需要时间慢慢长大。
cards.exampleTranslation: Seedlings need time to grow.

cards.example: 我们要爱护自己的品德。
cards.exampleTranslation: We should cherish our own moral character.

cards.example: 农民每天看禾苗有没有长高。
cards.exampleTranslation: The farmer checked daily whether the rice seedlings grew taller.

cards.example: 他太着急，结果做错了。
cards.exampleTranslation: He was too anxious and ended up making mistakes.

cards.example: 道德品质需要长期培养。
cards.exampleTranslation: Moral character needs long-term cultivation.

cards.example: 国君要关心百姓生活。
cards.exampleTranslation: Rulers should care about the lives of ordinary people.

cards.example: 好的政治应该让人民幸福。
cards.exampleTranslation: Good governance should make people happy.
